goal: Make the Parallel updater resolve STANDARD candidate runs from the authoritative build_work_candidate workflow for the frozen parallel-testpoint so unrelated Actions traffic cannot hide a valid downloadable build.
notes: Root cause confirmed: the installed updater asks the shared /actions/runs?branch=parallel&per_page=50 feed for Build work candidate. On a busy repository the exact verified testpoint run can fall outside that window, so the updater reports no download despite a valid artifact. UpdaterNetworkCompat now narrowly rewrites only the STANDARD parallel per_page=50 query to /actions/workflows/build_work_candidate.yml/runs while preserving branch=parallel provenance and the existing parallel->parallel-testpoint branch lookup. Updater version bumped to 2.10-parallel.3.
